fieldValues.title: RFC-004 Change I: Reserve protobuf compatibility for a future package
fieldValues.proposed_change: State that protobuf can be rendered from the same semantic IR where portable constructs are used, but protobuf-specific metadata is reserved for a future projection package.
fieldValues.rationale: Field numbers, reserved ranges, oneof names, and protobuf package names are target metadata rather than core schema meaning.
